text: We are team Space Oops. Students rarely get to fly a whole space mission, so we built one. Space Oops: design it, launch it, find out why it failed. Every choice is a trade-off: a better instrument costs mass, power and money. Pass the launch review, survive solar flares. Fail, learn, fly again, solo or as a crew of four. Then read a debrief grounded in NASA mission design guides.
